# mtncloud_catalog_order (Data Source)

Looks up one catalog order by ID or by name, including one made in the console. What you have ordered from the catalog (the console's Inventory), with each order's status. A name must match exactly one catalog order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_catalog_order" "example" {
  name = "web-prod"
}

output "catalog_order_status" {
  value = data.mtncloud_catalog_order.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the catalog order. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the catalog order, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `catalog_item` (String) Catalog item that was ordered, for example `Create Project`.
- `execution_status` (String) Status of the order's workflow run, or empty.
- `order_date` (String) When it was ordered (RFC 3339).
- `quantity` (Number) Quantity ordered.
- `status` (String) Order status, for example `ORDERED` or `FAILED`.
- `status_message` (String) Status message, or empty.
